Question Choices: How many five-letter codes contain DOG starting in the first position? There are 26 letters in the alphabet.
Hints: The code has the form DOGxx;Only two positions are free
Solution: The two free positions each have 26 choices, so there are 26^2 = 676 codes.

Question Choices: How many seven-letter all-letter codes do not contain the sequence MATH? There are 26 letters in the alphabet.
Hints: Count all seven-letter codes;MATH can start in positions 1 through 4;Subtract the four disjoint bad forms
Solution: There are 26^7 total codes. For each of 4 starting positions, the other 3 letters are free, giving 4 × 26^3 bad codes. The answer is 26^7 - 4 × 26^3 = 8031739872.
